about.text: What passes through the membrane when skimmed milk is ultrafiltered to make milk protein: water, lactose and minerals, with no protein to speak of. It is dried or concentrated and used as a lactose and mineral ingredient.

facts.v: 8–11 % in the powder; lactose at least 76 %
Milk protein concentrate (MPC) and milk protein isolate (MPI) made by ultrafiltration
